_comment: On-demand video re-processing, worked once per request id by the background transcriber (netlify/lib/video-reprocess.mjs). action: "retranscribe" (re-run the transcript with the current prompt; add "force": true to re-run one already at the current versions) or "rescore" (re-read the politician's Locker items from that video — or all their video items, without video_id — under the current rules). Example: { "id": "2026-11-28-example", "action": "retranscribe", "politician_id": "adelita_grijalva", "video_id": "G1xkgCCvPvY", "reason": "pre-v3 prompt" }
